reviews.quote: I Tested HP's OmniBook Ultra 14, a Gorgeous Ultraportable With Potent Processing Power

praises: Ryzen AI 9 365 + 1TB for $1,200 is absurd value — the whole reason this clearance SKU sells out
Radeon 880M actually plays esports titles and older AAA at 1080p, unlike iGPU siblings
50 TOPS XDNA NPU qualifies for Copilot+ locally
Strong multicore for compiling — beats same-price Intel U/V parts
Premium aluminium build and quad Poly speakers from the flagship line at budget price
complaints: 60Hz 1200p panel feels dated next to the 3K 120Hz OLED tiers
Battery a clear step down from Lunar Lake and Snapdragon tiers (~11h vs 14h+)
Older launch-gen chassis revision — 5MP cam vs 9MP on current units
Clearance stock: limited units, colour options gone

design_philosophy: The original Strix Point launch config of the OmniBook Ultra line, now the clearance value pick: flagship build and a genuinely capable Radeon iGPU at half the flagship price, at the cost of the older 60Hz panel.
rating_notes: Inferred from PCMag OmniBook Ultra 14 anchor. 880M gets gaming 5.0 (dataset: B390 ~5). 60Hz IPS panel → screen_quality 6.0. Notable value pick per rule 10 (previous gen at deep discount, price verified).
